atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLookback = input(60, "Coil Lookback", 20, 120, 1)
volVolLen = input(20, "Vol-of-Vol Length", 5, 60, 1)
coilLoadThresh = input(80.0, "Coil Load Threshold", 50.0, 95.0, 1.0)
volVolRiseBars = input(3, "VolVol Rise Bars", 1, 10, 1)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Multiple", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)
predictLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 60, 1)
predictThresh = input(0.55, "Predictability Threshold", 0.3, 0.9, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr = max(high - low, abs(high - close[1]), abs(low - close[1]))
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rng = high - low
rangeRatio = rng / max(atrVal, 0.0001)

atrCount = 0.0
rngCount = 0.0
coilBasis = rng
i = 1
while i <= coilLookback {
    atrCount := atrCount + (atrVal[i] <= atrVal ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    rngCount := rngCount + (rng[i] <= rng ? 1.0 : 0.0)
    coilBasis := min(coilBasis, rng[i])
    i := i + 1
}
atrRank = atrCount / coilLookback * 100.0
rngRank = rngCount / coilLookback * 100.0
coilLoad = 100.0 - (atrRank + rngRank) / 2.0

atrChg = (atrVal - atrVal[1]) / max(atrVal[1], 0.0001)
volVol = stdev(atrChg, volVolLen)
pastVV = volVolRiseBars == 1 ? volVol[1] : volVolRiseBars == 2 ? volVol[2] : volVolRiseBars == 3 ? volVol[3] : volVolRiseBars == 4 ? volVol[4] : volVolRiseBars == 5 ? volVol[5] : volVolRiseBars == 6 ? volVol[6] : volVolRiseBars == 7 ? volVol[7] : volVolRiseBars == 8 ? volVol[8] : volVolRiseBars == 9 ? volVol[9] : volVol[10]
volRising = volVol > pastVV

pastC = close[predictLen]
disp = abs(close - pastC)
sumAbs = 0.0
k = 0
while k < predictLen {
    sumAbs := sumAbs + abs(close[k] - close[k + 1])
    k := k + 1
}
predict = disp / max(sumAbs, 0.0001)

loaded = coilLoad > coilLoadThresh
predictable = predict >= predictThresh
warm = bar_index > coilLookback and bar_index > predictLen and bar_index > atrLen + volVolLen
expandEdge = rng > coilBasis * releaseMult and rng[1] <= coilBasis[1] * releaseMult

var lastRel = -1000.0
cooldownOk = bar_index - lastRel >= 10.0

buyRaw = loaded and volRising and expandEdge and close > open and warm and cooldownOk
sellRaw = loaded and volRising and expandEdge and close < open and warm and cooldownOk
buyPred = buyRaw and predictable
sellPred = sellRaw and predictable
anyUnpred = (buyRaw or sellRaw) and not predictable

if buyRaw or sellRaw {
    lastRel := bar_index
}

coilStateVal = loaded ? (predictable ? 2.0 + predict : 1.0 + predict * 0.5) : predict * 0.5

if buyPred {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Pred Bull", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellPred {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Pred Bear", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if anyUnpred {
    plotshape(bar_index, close, "Unpred Rel", "xcross", "#ff9933")
}
if loaded and coilLoad < 90.0 {
    bgcolor("#ff993322", "main")
}
if loaded and coilLoad >= 90.0 {
    bgcolor("#ff993355", "main")
}
if buyPred {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Pred Bull", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.2 * markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if sellPred {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Pred Bear", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.2 * markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if anyUnpred {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, close, "Unpred", "diamond", "#ff9933", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate")
}

plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
hline(coilLoadThresh, "#ff4477", "separate")
plot(predict, "Predictability", "#b48cff", 1, "separate")
hline(predictThresh, "#ffd43b", "separate")
plot3d(close, "Price Coil Ribbon", "ribbon", "#22cc88", "separate", 0)
plot3d(coilStateVal, "Coil State", "bars3d", "#ff9933", "separate", 1)

// Multi-Timeframe Siege Model — session extremes + confirmed 1h structure + model.* execution
sessStartH = input(0, "Session Start Hour", 0, 23, 1)
sessLenH = input(24, "Session Length Hours", 1, 72, 1)
structLb = input(3, "Structure Lookback Bars 1h", 1, 20, 1)
hardTicks = input(50, "Hard Stop Ticks", 1, 500, 1)
confThresh = input(60, "Confidence Threshold", 0, 100, 1)

barsPerHour = 12
sessLenBars = sessLenH * barsPerHour
htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)
sessHigh = highest(high, sessLenBars)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLenBars)
biasBull = htfHigh > htfHigh[structLb] and htfLow > htfLow[structLb]
biasBear = htfHigh < htfHigh[structLb] and htfLow < htfLow[structLb]
breakBull = htfClose > htfHigh[1]
breakBear = htfClose < htfLow[1]
noOverlapBull = htfLow > htfHigh[2]
noOverlapBear = htfHigh < htfLow[2]
beyondBull = htfClose > htfHigh[structLb]
beyondBear = htfClose < htfLow[structLb]
breakLongScore = breakBull ? 50 : 0
noOverlapLongScore = noOverlapBull ? 25 : 0
beyondLongScore = beyondBull ? 25 : 0
breakShortScore = breakBear ? 50 : 0
noOverlapShortScore = noOverlapBear ? 25 : 0
beyondShortScore = beyondBear ? 25 : 0
confLong = breakLongScore + noOverlapLongScore + beyondLongScore
confShort = breakShortScore + noOverlapShortScore + beyondShortScore
tickVal = 0.1
stopDist = hardTicks * tickVal
longStopPrice = close - stopDist
shortStopPrice = close + stopDist
buySig = crossover(close, sessHigh[1]) and biasBull and confLong >= confThresh
sellSig = crossunder(close, sessLow[1]) and biasBear and confShort >= confThresh
exitLong = crossunder(close, sessLow[1])
exitShort = crossover(close, sessHigh[1])
if buySig {
    model.confidence(confLong / 100)
    model.stopLoss(longStopPrice, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(confShort / 100)
    model.stopLoss(shortStopPrice, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if exitLong {
    model.longExit("siege")
}
if exitShort {
    model.shortExit("siege")
}
plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
